pilot: Reuse the previously frozen 126 source IDs (100 BENIGN, all 26 strict eligible attack annotations); verify packet references and source labels again, without loading any model.
length_unit: TCP segment bytes = IPv4 total length minus IPv4 header bytes, including TCP options
time_unit: integer nanoseconds; capture clock is an approximation of live helper time
input_direction: SYN initiator to responder; service port is responder port, never canonical endpoint B by assumption
directional_iat: max of separate direction maxima; first packet contributes zero; never subtract timestamps across directions
legacy_window: through and including first ingress FIN/RST; subsequent reverse traffic is unavailable to that decision
candidate_window: first RST, or the packet completing observation of FIN in both directions; closing grace 5000000000 ns from first FIN; late packets cause unscored expiration, never a backdated classification
candidate_timeout: No asynchronous timer is asserted; an expired connection with no further packet has no prediction. A future implementation needs bounded map retention and explicit expiration telemetry.
candidate_direction_start: Require observed client SYN; missing or ambiguous start remains unscored. Egress-first server identification is not guessed.
packet_policy: Existing strict CIC reconstruction subset: untagged Ethernet IPv4 IHL=20, unfragmented TCP, valid lengths. Count observed retransmissions, SYN/ACK/FIN/RST; do not deduplicate or sort timestamps.
arithmetic: Nonnegative signed-int64 feature domain, checked additions; invalid time/length/overflow rejects the offline window. Future kernel counters require checked u64 additions and a <=INT64_MAX snapshot.
label_gate: Original tuple/time/duration plus both directional packet/payload counters must cover the entire modeled window uniquely. Never extend an earlier FIN label interval by convenience.
split_gate: Training, validation and test must be disjoint in identifiable capture/attack campaign groups, with both binary classes represented. Use union groups for duplicate A or B vectors and known correlated campaigns; same partitions for both models. Do not split a known campaign into arbitrary rows/minutes to manufacture independence.
group_audit: Report capture-day groups, (day, attack category, source IP, destination IP) campaign proxies, endpoint-pair proxies, and exact source duplicates separately. Proxies do not establish truly independent sessions.
csv_cleaning: Inventory only: TCP; identity present; finite nonnegative integral selected numeric fields within int64; >=1 forward packet; port 0..65535; extrema valid for observed directions; duplicate Fwd Header Length columns must agree; exact duplicate source rows excluded deterministically. This never establishes CSV-to-kernel equivalence.
stop: If feature/label window or leakage-controlled dataset gate fails, do not train, quantize or integrate into TC. Report feasible work and missing sources instead.

future_training.scalers: fit separately on identical training IDs only
